evidence: Plaut. Merc. 2.3.41 crās agitō, perendiē agitō

phrases.latin: «Haec quoque,» inquit avia, «perendiē cum patre tuō vidēbis, sed vēra et magna.»
phrases.english: “You’ll see these too,” said Grandma, “the day after tomorrow with your dad, but real and big.”
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 86, 300.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
